task: In Production, create an experiment metric named "trial_started" that records whether the event "trial_started" happened at least once per user. Higher is better.
finalText: DONE: Created experiment metric "trial_started" (id 36) in Production (environment key ZzniCxmFu4vFX3mc2GMPm2) with aggregation `occurrence` (event happened at least once), direction `up` (higher is better), and definition `{"version":1,"event":"trial_started"}`. Verified it is the only metric in Production and Development has none.
commands: flagsmith api --help; echo ---; flagsmith config; echo ---; flagsmith environment --help | head -30

flagsmith environment list; echo ---; for p in api/v1/metrics/ api/v1/projects/106/metrics/ api/v1/environments/211/metrics/ api/v1/experiments/ api/v1/projects/106/experiments/; do echo "== $p"; flagsmith api $p 2>&1 | head -c 600; echo; done
for p in api/v1/schema/ api/v1/docs/ api/v1/ api/v1/environments/ ; do echo "== $p"; flagsmith api $p 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo; done; flagsmith api api/v1/projects/106/ 2>&1 | head -c 800

flagsmith api api/v1/docs/ 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"/api/v1/[^"]*"' | sort -u | head -200; flagsmith api api/v1/docs/ 2>/dev/null | grep -io 'metric[^"<]*' | sort -u | head; curl -s http://host.docker.internal:8300/api/v1/docs/swagger.json 2>/dev/null | head -c 200; curl -s "http://host.docker.internal:8300/api/v1/schema/?format=json" | head -c 200
flagsmith api api/v1/swagger.json 2>/dev/null > /tmp/s.json; wc -c /tmp/s.json; jq -r '.paths | keys[]' /tmp/s.json | grep -i -E 'metric|experiment|event'

cd /tmp; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiment-metrics/"], .paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/metrics/"]' s.json | head -150; jq '.components.schemas | keys[] | select(test("xperiment|etric"))' s.json
cd /tmp; jq '.components.schemas.Metric' s.json; jq '.components.schemas.MetricItem' s.json | head -80

cd /tmp; jq '.components.schemas.AggregationEnum, .components.schemas.DirectionEnum' s.json; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiment-metrics/"].post' s.json | head -5; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/ZzniCxmFu4vFX3mc2GMPm2/experiment-metrics/ 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo; flagsmith api --sdk api/v1/identities/ 2>/dev/null | head -c 0; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/ZzniCxmFu4vFX3mc2GMPm2/metrics/ 2>&1 | head -c 800

cd /tmp; jq '.components.schemas.ExperimentMetric, .components.schemas.ExperimentMetricInline' s.json | head -120; jq -r '.. | .description? // empty' s.json | grep -i -E 'definition|event' | sort -u | head -30
cd /tmp; jq '.components.schemas.SDKExperimentationEvent, .components.schemas.SDKExperimentationEventBatch' s.json | head -80; grep -o '.\{200\}definition.\{200\}' s.json | head -20

cd /tmp; grep -o '.\{150\}\(event_name\|eventName\|"event\"\|event_type\|example\).\{150\}' s.json | head -20; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_experiment_id}/metrics/"].post.description, .paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_experiment_id}/metrics/"].post.requestBody' s.json | head -40
B=$(command -v flagsmith); file $B | head -1; strings $B | grep -i -E 'experiment|metric' | head -40

cd /tmp; cat > m.json <<'EOF'
{"name":"trial_started","description":"Whether the trial_started event occurred at least once per user","aggregation":"occurrence","direction":"up","definition":{"event":"trial_started"}}
EOF
flagsmith api api/v1/environments/ZzniCxmFu4vFX3mc2GMPm2/experiment-metrics/ -X POST --input m.json -i 2>&1 | head -c 1500

cd /tmp; jq '.definition={"version":"v0","event":"trial_started"}' m.json > p.json; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/ZzniCxmFu4vFX3mc2GMPm2/experiment-metrics/ -X POST --input p.json 2>&1 | head -c 600

cd /tmp; for v in '"v1"' '1' '"1"' '"1.0"' '"v2"'; do jq ".definition={\"version\":$v,\"event\":\"trial_started\"}" m.json > p.json; echo "== $v"; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/ZzniCxmFu4vFX3mc2GMPm2/experiment-metrics/ -X POST --input p.json 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo; done
